mainEntity.name: What is a master prompt, and is it the same as a finished AI product?

acceptedAnswer.text: A master prompt is a reusable set of instructions that defines an assistant’s role, responsibilities, workflow, inputs, outputs, boundaries, and approval requirements. It is a blueprint, not a guaranteed software product or autonomous business. Run My AI Business presents customizable master prompts through an external resource library and encourages adaptation to the owner’s niche and goals. Key factors: platform capabilities, integrations, permissions, source material, and the quality of your instructions. Practical guidance: change one variable at a time, save versions, test edge cases, and document what the assistant cannot do.
acceptedAnswer.description: A master prompt is a reusable instruction blueprint for an AI assistant. It can define roles, steps, inputs, outputs, and approval rules, but it is not automatically a finished software product. Actual performance also depends on the AI platform, connected tools, permissions, data, and testing.
